description: Even-channel 4₁ Kashaev κ_n are Gevrey-1 divergent; Borel singularity A from the large-order fit — the quantitative growth-class obstruction to a term-by-term 4₁↔Q_β bridge.

result.verdict: Even-channel κ_n are Gevrey-1 DIVERGENT: the reliable ratios ['1.31913', '3.63096', '4.933', '6.46381', '7.99775'] rise ~linearly in n (r_n=(1/A)n+β/A), giving a finite Borel singularity A=0.61766156 (≈ Vol(4₁)/2π × 1.9119; β≈0.00735). This is the quantitative form of the growth-class obstruction: a Gevrey-1 divergent series cannot equal the CONVERGENT Q_β ladder (ratio→117.41, KC8) term-by-term, so the 4₁↔Q_β bridge is necessarily the Borel/median (Faddeev Φ_b) resummation — i.e. the analytic continuation from the Kashaev locus |q|=1 to the real substrate q₀>1, NOT an ℏ↔u reparametrisation. Complements (does not duplicate) the Φ_b construction on #3544/#3596. No fit; no c_k wired; no tier change.
